provenance.grasp_origin_note: The normalized GraspNet +X/+Y/+Z axes are approach/closing/binormal. The official pose origin is the Robotiq base, 6 mm forward of gripper_mount_link; gripper_tip_position_xyz remains separate contact evidence.
provenance.pregrasp_note: A 70 mm additional approach-axis standoff leaves the official 136 mm fingertips 70 mm clear of the contact point and matches the validated fixture clearance envelope.
provenance.orientation_policy: Preserve every candidate rotation; no fixed wrist orientation or pose preview is permitted.
